body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: d18b8641bd56d4bc0ef9b810dc7742c4cbe06b67 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review because the change affects posted G-code.

- The five posts use the existing comment helper. They add a comment only when the complete block fits the 80-character limit. They do not cut executable words.
- I checked all lines in the five new golden files. The comments match the words. The lathe keeps its tool and spindle meanings. No existing golden file changed.
- No UI file changed. Screenshots are not required.

Local checks used a separate worktree with a trial merge of upstream/main at afa037b77ffafc490a4dba32a49589c1f39fb3e1. The merge had no conflict. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate: post unit and integration tests, 56 suites | 514 passed, 0 failed |
| Quick gate: mapped app tests, 68 suites | 487 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| camcraft-post clippy, all targets, warnings denied | Passed |
| Remove the Fanuc comment declaration in memory | Both Fanuc tests failed with the expected missing-form refusal |
| Remove the Fanuc lathe block-length guard in memory | The budget test failed at the one-character overflow |
| Run the same test harness without mutations | All 10 tests passed |

The mutation harness was outside the checkout. It changed script text only in memory. No PR source file was changed.

Requested changes: none.

The checks did not use a controller simulator or a physical machine. The new Explain fixtures do not cover arcs, drilling cycles, inch units, or live tooling. The full post test set passed. The 80-character limit applies to added explanations; it does not shorten existing blocks or header notes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: d18b8641bd56d4bc0ef9b810dc7742c4cbe06b67 -->
Cost: 149,507 agent tokens (about $0.65 upper estimate), 40 tool calls, 32 minutes (08:06-08:38 UTC).
Work: one full local review - worktree, trial merge (clean), explain.rs and new test read, law greps, gate quick --only post (514 tests) and --only app (487 tests), clippy -p camcraft-post (clean).
Method: the agent's completion report carries this token total. The agent's prose estimate (~120k) was its own count without the usage meter; the reported total replaces it, same basis as the #1793 and #1787 rows.
Note: this PR merged at dc44993fc before this row was posted; the review itself was counted on the head (COMMENTED 08:36:36Z).
